spec.kitLine: ■ last bullet hits → Crit Rate normal ▲
spec.scope: NORMAL-ATTACK-scoped crit only — 'Critical Rate of normal attacks' is the scoped stat (critRateNormalPct), never generic critRatePct; must not touch skill/burst/rider crit rolls.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec: 5 (wall-clock seconds, explicit 'for 5 sec'). With ammo 6 + ~1s charge/shot + 141f reload, the magazine cycle is ~8.3s, so the buff has real DOWNTIME between last-bullet procs — uptime < 100% is part of the faithful model.
spec.triggerIdentity: lastBullet (per-magazine, fires on the 6th round of each mag). No FB gate, no charge gate.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Generic critRatePct on a shotFired/passive trigger: over-credits the whole team's skill/burst/rider crit AND grants ~100% uptime instead of the per-magazine 5s window.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Filter buffApply by stat==='critRateNormalPct' && value===14.64: first application coincides with helm's 6th shot (after a reload event boundary), expiresFrame ≈ apply+300f, and application count over the fight ≈ magazine count (not shot count). RED under nearest-wrong: stat==='critRatePct' or per-shot application cadence.
spec.inertness: Skill-proc and burst damage events' crit rate must NOT move when this line is toggled; teammates' non-normal buckets unchanged.

spec.kitLine: ■ Full Charge attack → Recovers 0.59% Max HP
spec.scope: Fires on every full-charge attack. Helm is SR (chargeFrames 60) — in-sim every trigger pull is a full-charge shot, so this resolves to a per-shot trigger.
spec.durationSemantics: Instant heal per activation, no duration.
spec.triggerIdentity: shotFired (SR full-charge each pull). ⚑ if the engine ever models partial charges this needs a charge gate, but for SR steady-state shotFired is the faithful key.
spec.targetSet: allies (all allies) — heal amount scales off the SKILL USER's final Max HP (caster-scaled, emitted flat-resolved).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Skipped as 'defensive, no damage'. This is the classic tandem trap: the control fixture seats CROWN (B2), whose kit keys off 'when recovery takes effect' — a per-shot team heal from helm drives crown's recovery-triggered blocks every single shot. Dropping it silently changes crown's output in every helm comp.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Heal events targeting all 5 units fire once per helm shot (~every charge cycle); in a comp with crown, crown's recovery-trigger buffApply count tracks helm's shot count. RED under nearest-wrong: zero heal events / crown's recovery blocks fire only from crown's own kit.
spec.inertness: Helm's OWN damage buckets must not move from the heal itself (no atkOfMaxHpPct consumer in her kit; ally-granted HP never feeds conversions).

spec.kitLine: ■ Full Charge attack → Fills Burst Gauge 14.31%
spec.scope: Per full-charge attack, same block as the heal.
spec.triggerIdentity: shotFired (same resolution as the heal line — SR full charge per pull).
spec.targetSet: Team burst gauge (engine: fillGauge effect; the 'Affects all allies' header is cosmetic for a team-level pool).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoded as burstGenPct (a passive % scaler on her gauge CONTRIBUTION) instead of fillGauge (an instant % pool fill per proc) — or dropped as non-damage. At 14.31% per shot × 6-round magazines this is a massive rotation accelerator; mis-encoding materially shifts every Full Burst timestamp and thus every FB-window buff in the comp.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: With the block present, fullBurstStart events come measurably earlier/more often than with it patched out (withPatchedOverride removing only this effect); the fill is event-per-shot, not a passive scaler. RED under nearest-wrong: FB cadence identical to the no-fill baseline or a passive burstGenPct buffApply instead of per-shot fills.
spec.inertness: Must not add damage directly — only rotation timing moves.

spec.nearestWrongModel: Mis-bucketed as attackDamagePct/partsDamagePct-as-generic-damage. partsDamagePct exists in the schema and is INERT in v1 (partless boss, per the standing boss rule) — the faithful encoding is a live buffApply that moves nothing.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat==='partsDamagePct' value===3.08 present at t=0 for all allies, AND totals(res) identical with the block patched out. RED under nearest-wrong: any damage delta from this line.
spec.inertness: ZERO board movement — this line moving any unit's total is itself the failure.

spec.scope: Generic Attack Damage (Damage Up bucket, attackDamagePct) — applies to all damage of all allies, not normal-only.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec: 10 (explicit seconds — matches the FB window).
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter — 'when entering Full Burst' fires on ANY team Full Burst, including rotations where the OTHER B3 casts. NOT burstCast.
spec.nearestWrongModel: burstCast (fires only on helm's own burst rotations) — the canonical trigger-identity misread. Under-credits every rotation the co-B3 takes. Second-nearest: atkPct instead of attackDamagePct (wrong bucket, dilution behavior differs).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In a dual-B3 comp where the OTHER carry casts the burst on a given rotation (controlComp(carry) with helm in the second B3 slot), buffApply stat==='attackDamagePct' value===27.87 still fires at that fullBurstStart. RED under burstCast: no application on other-B3 rotations. NOTE: on a comp where helm is the SOLE caster the two readings coincide — the test MUST use the two-B3 fixture to discriminate.
spec.inertness: Must not apply outside FB windows; no application at burst cast pre-FB.

spec.kitLine: ■ Full Charge hit → 178.98% ATK add'l dmg
spec.scope: Per full-charge HIT (on-hit rider). SR per-pull full charge → rides every landed shot.
spec.nearestWrongModel: (a) Given core eligibility (core:true) — riders get NO core unless text says 'core strike'; (b) given the +30% range bonus — universally OFF on riders (noRange forced); (c) noFb:true — WRONG here: function-damage riders take the FB +50% by landing timing, default ON; (d) encoded as a DoT or hitCount:N cadence.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: One flatDamage event (mult 178.98) per helm shot event, 1:1; those landing inside FB carry fbMajorApplied===true; rangeApplied===false and no core bucket on the rider while helm's own weapon shots keep their normal core rate. RED under nearest-wrong: core/range credited on rider events, or fbMajorApplied always false.
spec.inertness: Rider count must equal shot count — no extra procs from reloads/bursts.

spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast — and burst-cast instant damage is always FB-EXEMPT (lands before the FB window opens): noFb true.
spec.targetSet: enemy (single boss in v1; the highest-ATK selector collapses to the boss).
spec.nearestWrongModel: FB +50% applied to the nuke (the taxonomy-9 trap) — a straight ×1.5 over-credit on an 8236.8% hit; or keyed to fullBurstEnter (would also over-fire on the co-B3's rotations).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Exactly one damage event with mult 8236.8 per helm burstCast event, with fbMajorApplied===false / inFullBurst false at resolution; count over the fight === helm's burstCast count, not the fullBurstStart count. RED under nearest-wrong: fbMajorApplied true, or nuke count === team FB count.
spec.inertness: No nuke on rotations where the co-B3 bursts.

spec.kitLine: ■ allies: Recovers 54.45% of attack dmg as HP
spec.scope: Team lifesteal: each ally's attack damage converts to HP for the window.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast applies the window; the healing itself is per-hit while active.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Two opposite traps: (a) silently dropped with no unmodeled record; (b) modeled as a per-hit heal-event stream — which, with crown in the fixture, would fire crown's recovery trigger on EVERY ally hit for 10s, a massive spurious tandem credit. The schema excerpt has no lifesteal primitive (heal effects exist only as discrete recovery events), so the defensible v1 disposition is unmodeled-verbatim WITH an explicit note that any future encoding must reconcile the crown-recovery interaction deliberately, not incidentally.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: override.unmodeled.burst contains this line verbatim; crown's recovery-trigger buffApply count does NOT jump during helm's 10s post-burst windows (i.e. no accidental per-hit heal stream). RED if: line absent from unmodeled AND no block encodes it, or crown recovery procs scale with team hit count post-burst.
spec.inertness: Zero damage movement in v1; crown's recovery cadence unchanged by this line.

spec.kitLine: ■ self: Charge Dmg Mult ▲ for 10 round(s)
spec.scope: Self-only, charge bucket: chargeDamagePct 158.4 (additive percentage points in the charge bucket) — helm is SR so every shot consumes it.
spec.durationSemantics: ROUNDS, not seconds: durationShots: 10, NO durationSec. The 10-round window SPANS her reload — ammo 6 @ ~1s/charge + 141f (~2.35s) reload means 10 rounds take ≈12.4s wall-clock; shots 7–10 land post-reload and MUST still carry the buff, and the 10th shot itself still benefits (decrement-after-dispatch).
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (self mode inside her own burst block) — fires only on rotations helm herself bursts, NOT on the co-B3's Full Bursts.
spec.nearestWrongModel: durationSec: 10 — the single most likely shared-prior misread on this kit. Under it the buff dies at t=cast+10s (≈ shot 8), silently shaving the post-reload shots; it also wrongly persists if she idles. Secondary misread: fullBurstEnter keying (over-credits co-B3 rotations).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat==='chargeDamagePct' value===158.4 carries durationShots===10 and NO meaningful expiresFrame; helm's 9th and 10th post-cast shots (which land after her reload, >10s after cast) still show the elevated charge-bucket mult, and the 11th does not. RED under durationSec: shots 9–10 revert to base charge mult. Also assert zero application on rotations where only the co-B3 bursts.
spec.inertness: No allies receive it (self-only); no application on non-helm burst rotations.

burst: Recovers 54.45% of attack damage as HP for 10 sec.

notes: Expected shared-prior misreads, in priority order: (1) burst self-buff 'for 10 round(s)' encoded as durationSec:10 — with helm's 6-round magazine + 141f reload the faithful durationShots window runs ~12.4s and spans a reload, so the two readings diverge by her last ~2-3 buffed shots every burst; this is the kit's highest-leverage assertion. (2) skill2's Attack Damage line keyed burstCast instead of fullBurstEnter — CRITICAL FIXTURE CAVEAT: on any comp where helm is the sole/actual B3 caster the two triggers coincide and the test proves nothing; the discriminating run must be the dual-B3 controlComp where the OTHER carry casts, asserting helm's 27.87 buffApply still fires. Conversely her burst-block lines (nuke, charge self-buff) must NOT fire on those rotations — same fixture, inverse assertion. (3) The skill1 heal + gauge block dropped as 'defensive': crown sits in the control fixture and keys off recovery, and 14.31% gauge/shot materially accelerates every FB timestamp — both are load-bearing through tandem/rotation, not through helm's own damage. (4) Burst nuke given the +50% FB major (burst-cast damage is FB-exempt) and the 178.98% rider given core or range (riders get neither; it DOES take FB by landing timing). (5) 'Critical Rate of normal attacks' widened to generic critRatePct. (6) The lifesteal line: no schema primitive — verify it lands verbatim in unmodeled AND that no encoding sneaks in a per-hit heal stream, which would spuriously machine-gun crown's recovery trigger. Fixture hygiene: since helm is baked into controlComp's fixed B3 slot, the driver must ensure the unit-under-test helm isn't double-seated (use the helm flag in controlComp's signature accordingly). All magnitudes are literal kit text (DATAMINED); no CALIBRATED ⚑ values are needed anywhere in this kit — a shipped override inventing one should be challenged.
